title: Source exit with bounded retrieval — wrong entries crowd out correct ones

notes: Source-exit roster + bounded 4-entry record with 2 retrieval slots.
The contamination agent writes wrong entries before exiting. With only 2 retrieval slots, later agents may retrieve the contamination entries and miss correct ones.
Combines the source-exit mechanism with the bounded-record mechanism.
Compare bounded vs unbounded to see if the retrieval bottleneck makes source exit worse.
